entities.title: Games saved on the device
entities.summary: user://computer.json holds the game against the computer; user://history.json the signed-out history, newest first, at most 50.
consumers: Later versions of the game on the same device (Continue, and the signed-out History)
scripts/reference/local_history.py, which writes history.json for the reference render
guarantees: Each game has the server's GameView shape: id (local-… on the device), kind computer, level, white, black, moves in UCI, result, reason, drawOffer, created, updated, events
The computer's side has no id and a name starting "Stockfish"
A file that is missing or not JSON reads as no game
entities.compatibility: A change to the shape has to read the files earlier versions wrote, or players lose their saved game and signed-out history.
